dossier_meta.paper: On the Hat Guessing Number of Graphs
dossier_meta.catalog_title: Question on Typical Hat Guessing Number of G(n,1/2)
dossier_meta.statement_text: What is the typical asymptotic behavior of the hat guessing number of the random graph $G(n,1/2)$? In particular, is $\mathrm{HG}(G(n,1/2))$ equal to $o(n)$ with high probability?
dossier_meta.context_text: The paper improves the known lower bound from $(2-o(1))\log_2 n$ to $n^{1-o(1)}$ with high probability, but the true order of growth remains unknown. The upper bound is $n$ trivially.
